{{Top}}
'''Flag Lieutenant''' was a rank within most [[Navy/Legends|space navies]], particularly the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]]. The specific title referred to a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who had been assigned as the aide of a ranking [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], usually an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]. During the later stages of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] of [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Tahiri Veila]] served as the flag lieutenant for [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]].
